source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Once per battle, when an enemy model's move forces you to remove one of your [Cult Ambush](vsdata:ability/genestealer-cults.cult-ambush) markers, if a model of yours with this ability is on the battlefield, that marker can instead be moved to a spot on the battlefield up to 12" from one of your models with this ability and over 8" horizontally from every enemy unit. If no such spot exists, the marker is removed as usual and this ability does not count as used.

detail.trigger: enemy movement would remove Cult Ambush marker
detail.condition: at least one friendly model with ability on battlefield
